claims.claim_text_normalized: The Region Proposal Network shares full-image convolutional features with the detection network.
claims.evidence_quote_short: we introduce a Region Proposal Network (RPN) that shares full-image convolutional features with the detection network

claims.claim_text_normalized: Faster R-CNN achieves state-of-the-art object detection accuracy on PASCAL VOC 2007, 2012, and MS COCO datasets.
claims.evidence_quote_short: achieving state-of-the-art object detection accuracy on PASCAL VOC 2007, 2012, and MS COCO datasets

claims.claim_text_normalized: The RPN is a fully convolutional network that simultaneously predicts object bounds and objectness scores.
claims.evidence_quote_short: An RPN is a fully convolutional network that simultaneously predicts object bounds and objectness scores at each position.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Selective Search is an order of magnitude slower than efficient detection networks.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Selective Search is an order of magnitude slower, at 2 seconds per image in a CPU implementation.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The marginal cost for computing proposals with RPN is small, e.g., 10ms per image.
claims.evidence_quote_short: the marginal cost for computing proposals is small ( e.g., 10ms per image).

claims.claim_text_normalized: Faster R-CNN with VGG-16 has a frame rate of 5fps on a GPU.
claims.evidence_quote_short: our detection system has a frame rate of 5fps ( including all steps ) on a GPU

claims.claim_text_normalized: RPNs are trained end-to-end to generate high-quality region proposals.
claims.evidence_quote_short: The RPN is trained end-to-end to generate high-quality region proposals

claims.claim_text_normalized: The region proposal step is the test-time computational bottleneck in state-of-the-art detection systems.
claims.evidence_quote_short: proposals are the test-time computational bottleneck in state-of-the-art detection systems.
